row.title: REPO-CONFORM-1: seed checks machine-readable repo files
row.body: Seed carries autonomy/repo-conformance.json and scripts/repoconform.py, run by the seed unittest suite. Next: same check on every org repo (issue 2577). Lesson: checks.yml is on the worker-gate deny list, so wire new checks through the seed test suite.
